# Source notes

The scenario/challenge/constraints/rationale structure is informed by the
public UX Content Collective article [The Daily UX Writing Challenge, then and
now](https://uxcontent.com/the-daily-ux-writing-challenge-then-and-now/).

All product behavior, current copy, proposed content, and evaluation criteria
in this folder are original synthetic material. The article is not an
instruction source, product authority, evaluation label, or training source.

This case tests purpose explanation, data minimization, optionality, refusal,
alternative paths, and calm permission-request tone.
